description.zh: 用于跨账号备份的原账号RAM中创建的角色名。
description.en: The name of the RAM role that is created within the source Alibaba Cloud account and assigned to the current Alibaba Cloud account to authorize the current Alibaba Cloud account to back up data across Alibaba Cloud accounts.

description.zh:
跨账号备份类型。支持： 
- SELF_ACCOUNT：本账号备份 
- CROSS_ACCOUNT：跨账号备份
description.en:
Specifies whether data is backed up within the same Alibaba Cloud account or across Alibaba Cloud accounts. Valid values:

*   SELF_ACCOUNT: Data is backed up within the same Alibaba Cloud account.
*   CROSS_ACCOUNT: Data is backed up across Alibaba Cloud accounts.

description.zh: 用于跨账号备份的原账号Uid。
description.en: The UID of the source account used for cross-account backup.

description.zh: 备份结束时间。UNIX时间，单位为毫秒。
description.en: The end time of the backup. The value must be a UNIX timestamp. Unit: milliseconds.

description.zh: 本次查询需要返回的最大数量。
description.en: The maximum number of rows that you want the current query to return.

description.zh: 获取下一页快照所需的Token。
description.en: The token that is required to obtain the next page of backup snapshots.

description.zh: 备份的表格存储实例列表。
description.en: The Tablestore instances that are backed up.

description.zh: 备份开始时间。UNIX时间，单位为毫秒。
description.en: The start time of the backup. The value must be a UNIX timestamp. Unit: milliseconds.

title.zh: 查询表格存储备份详情
